title: Otto C. Hellmuth

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. REGISTRY
D 86880
Special Branch - J.l. O. Station,
REPORT
Date. September 30, 40
Subject. Otto C. HELLMUTH, German born Argentinian.

Made by. D. S. I. Fitts. Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

Otto C. HELLMUTH was born in Germany of German
parents some 51 years ago. At the age of fifteen
he proceeded to Buenos Aires where he has lived the
greater part of his life. He is now an Argentine
citizen, having acquired that nationality through
naturalization many years ago. He speaks excellent
French, English with a marked German accent, Spanish
and, of course, German. He came to Shanghai just
two years ago and since that time has been residing
at the Park Hotel, Bubbling Well Road. During this
period he has made numerous trips to Japan
and an occasional one to Hongkong ostensibly on
business purposes. At present he is in Japan but
is expected to return at any time. He last left this
port in the ss. Nitta Maru on July 26, 1940.
Even when he is away from Shanghai, his suite -
No. 403 - at the Park Hotel is reserved for his sole
use.
He arrived in Shanghai as a director, special
delegate and adviser of Messrs. STERNS Ltd., London,
on behalf of whose interests he had been instructed to
increase the volume of commerce effected by this
concern in the Far East. Messrs. STERNS Ltd. are
large-scale manufacturers of lubricating oils and
greases and though the concern is a British company
it is said in well-informed local quarters that the
organization is or was controlled by German interests.

特别分部 - J.l. O. 巡捕房，
报告
日期：1940年9月30日
事由：奥托·C·赫尔姆特（Otto C. HELLMUTH），德裔阿根廷人。

制作人：D. S. I. 菲茨（Fitts）。转呈人：D. I. 克劳福德（Crawford）。

奥托·C·赫尔姆特于51年前出生于德国，父母均为德国人。十五岁时，他前往布宜诺斯艾利斯，此后大半生均居住于此。他多年前通过归化取得阿根廷国籍，现为阿根廷公民。他能讲流利的法语、带有明显德国口音的英语、西班牙语以及当然的德语。他于两年前抵达上海，自此一直居住在静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）的国际饭店（Park Hotel）。在此期间，他多次前往日本，并偶尔以公务为名前往香港。目前他在日本，但预计随时可能返回。他最后一次离开本埠是于1940年7月26日乘坐“新田丸”号轮船（ss. Nitta Maru）。即使在他离开上海期间，他在国际饭店的套房——403室——仍专供其使用。

他作为伦敦斯特恩斯有限公司（Messrs. STERNS Ltd.）的董事、特别代表和顾问抵达上海，奉命增加该公司在远东地区的商业交易量。斯特恩斯有限公司是大规模生产润滑油和润滑脂的制造商，尽管该公司是一家英国公司，但据本地消息灵通人士称，该组织由德国利益方控制或曾经由其控制。

Subject....................................................................................................
Made by....................Forwarded by....................................................

Messrs. STERNS Ltd. have been in the China
market for several years and at one period carried
large contracts for the supply of oil and grease
to the Chinese National Government, most of their
orders emanating from the Chinese railways. During
the past two and three years, however, it would
seem that the volume of traffic enjoyed by this
company in China has greatly decreased while their
interests with Japan have, on the other hand, steadily
increased.

In charge of the agency of this organization
in this part of the world was the German concern
of Messrs. CARLOWITZ & Co., but upon the outbreak
of the current European conflict, the agency was
taken over by a Frenchman, R. F. PIRARD, residing
at 2, Lidget Apartments, 115 route Ferguson. He
has an office in the National Commercial Bank Building,
406 Kiangse Road.

Some doubt now exists as to whether HELLMUTH
is any longer connected with Messrs. STERNS Ltd.
That he is still interested in the oil business
is quite certain but on whose behalf is at present
a little obscure. Before the outbreak of hostilities
in Europe associated with him were PIRARD and a
Russian, N. V. OBOLSKY, who was formerly employed
in the oil-department of Messrs. CARLOWITZ & CO.
OBOLSKY resides at Flat 1, Liberty Apartments, rue
Maresca. It is known that HELLMUTH is still in
contact with these two individuals.

斯特恩斯有限公司（Messrs. STERNS Ltd.）进入中国市场已有数年，曾在一段时期内承担向中国政府供应大量石油和润滑脂的合同，其大部分订单来自中国铁路。然而，在过去两三年间，该公司在中国的业务量似乎大幅减少，而另一方面，其在日本的利益却稳步增长。

负责该组织在本地区代理机构的是德国商号卡罗威茨公司（Messrs. CARLOWITZ & Co.），但在当前欧洲冲突爆发后，该代理权由居住在费格森路（route Ferguson）115号利吉特公寓（Lidget Apartments）2号的法国人 R. F. 皮拉德（PIRARD）接管。他在江西路（Kiangse Road）406号国家商业银行大楼设有办公室。

目前对于赫尔姆特是否仍与斯特恩斯有限公司有关联存在一些疑问。可以肯定的是，他仍然从事石油业务，但目前代表谁的利益尚不清楚。在欧洲敌对行动爆发前，与他有关联的人是皮拉德和一位俄罗斯人 N. V. 奥博尔斯基（OBOLSKY），后者曾受雇于卡罗威茨公司的石油部门。奥博尔斯基居住在马思南路（rue Maresca）自由公寓（Liberty Apartments）1号单元。已知赫尔姆特仍与这两人保持联系。

Subject....................................................................................

Made by...........................Forwarded by....................................................

HELLMUTH, who is either a bachelor or a
widower, always appears to be well supplied with
funds. He lives quietly though well but, apart
from the society of a comely young Russian girl
introduced to him by OBOLSKY, mixes very little
in local circles. He has few German friends
as one would expect but he has been heard to say
on more than one occasion that though he was no
longer a German, at heart he still remained so
and fully expected to see the Nazis emerge victorious
from the present conflict. He gives one the
impression of being pro-German in his outlook
upon world affairs.
He was in Hongkong just after the outbreak
of war between Germany and Great Britain and, it
is said, had a bad motoring accident there in
which he was injured. In certain circles in
Shanghai it is felt that had he been working
at that time on behalf of German interests the
Colony authorities would have taken steps to have
had him detained.
Should any further information come to the
notice of this office regarding HELLMUTH, a
subsequent report will be immediately submitted.

                                J. A. Pick
                                D.S.I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

事由....................................................................................

制作人...........................转呈人....................................................

赫尔姆特无论是单身还是鳏夫，似乎总是资金充裕。他生活安静但优渥，除了与奥博尔斯基介绍给他的一位年轻漂亮的俄罗斯女孩交往外，很少参与本地社交圈。正如人们所预料的那样，他的德国朋友很少，但人们不止一次听到他说，虽然他不再是德国人，但在内心深处他仍然是德国人，并完全预期纳粹将从当前的冲突中获胜。他给人的印象是，在世界事务的看法上持亲德立场。

在德国与英国战争爆发后不久，他曾身处香港，据说在那里遭遇了一次严重的车祸并受伤。在上海某些圈子中，人们认为，如果当时他代表德国利益行事，殖民地当局会采取措施将其拘留。

若本办公室注意到关于赫尔姆特的任何进一步信息，将立即提交后续报告。

                                J. A. 皮克（Pick）
                                D.S.I.

D. C. （特别分部）。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section I, Special Branch: Station,
REPORT
File No. REGISTRY
Date January 17, 40
19

Subject Otto Hellmuth.

Made by J.P.S. Killingbeck. Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

With reference to an enquiry regarding
one Otto HELLUTH, this man has for some considerable
time occupied a suite at the Park Hotel and is
registered there as an Argentine Subject. He is
frequently away from Shanghai, apparently on business
trips most of which take him to Japan. He is
reported to be engaged in the oil and petrol trade
and has some connection with the firm of Carlowitz
& Co., Shanghai. It is believed that most of his
mail is received through this firm but mail, mainly
from Japan, is addressed to him at the Park Hotel.
This mail consists greatly of correspondence apparently
of a business nature.

It is reported that Hellmuth is a fluent
German and French linguist.

Killingbeck
D. P. S.

A. C. ( Special Branch ).

报告
档案号：登记处
日期：1940年1月17日

事由：奥托·赫尔姆特（Otto Hellmuth）。

制作人：J.P.S. 基林贝克（Killingbeck）。转呈人：D. I. 克劳福德（Crawford）。

关于查询一名名为奥托·赫尔卢特（Otto HELLUTH）的人士，此人已在国际饭店占据一套套房相当长一段时间，并在那里登记为阿根廷籍臣民。他经常离开上海，显然是进行商务旅行，其中大部分行程前往日本。据报道，他从事石油和汽油贸易，并与上海卡罗威茨公司（Carlowitz & Co.）有一些关联。据信，他的大部分邮件是通过该公司接收的，但主要来自日本的邮件是直接寄到他在国际饭店的地址。这些邮件主要由看似属于商业性质的信件组成。

据报道，赫尔姆特精通德语和法语。

基林贝克（Killingbeck）
D. P. S.

A. C. （特别分部）。
